name: app-case-study-website-divider-strip
title: Black divider strip with outlined pill and one-line description
whatItIs: A very thin, wide black strip with an outlined pill labelled 'WEBSITE' at the left and a tiny paragraph at the right where part of the text is white and part grey.
whatItMeans: Quiet structure; it acts as a chapter break in a long case study.
techniques: Use an outlined pill as a chapter label.
Split a sentence into bright and dim tones to show emphasis.
Keep everything tiny on pure black to make a subtle divider.
bestFor: Long case studies with several deliverables

vocabulary.definition: A slim band that labels a new section.
A capsule with a thin border and no fill.
Lowering the brightness of secondary words.
